findings.screen: Docs newly created document, dirty editor
reproduction: Create a new Markdown document on an owned empty instance.
Wait for the file watcher event without opening an external editor.
findings.expected: Own creation/save events do not display conflict warnings; actual changed disk content still does.
findings.actual: Safari displayed This file changed in Obsidian while a local draft was open immediately after creation. Saving and reload worked.
evidence: Native Safari 27.0 accessibility tree after creating safari-proof.md on the synthetic fixture.
Docs watcher checks path and dirty state without comparing event hash.
findings.verification: Nine watcher regressions; real desktop/phone own-create and second-client conflict checks; native Safari new-document reproduction, mixed-language save and reload.

findings.title: new empty draft retains the stored template word count
reproduction: Create a new Markdown document and inspect its word count before typing.
findings.expected: The empty editor is reported as empty.
findings.actual: The editor was empty but the count still described the generated two-word heading on disk.
evidence: Native Safari accessibility tree showed an empty source editor beside 2 words.
findings.verification: Both fresh full browser runs assert the empty editor reports empty document before typing, at desktop and phone widths; all 587 JavaScript tests pass. Native Safari confirms the same empty-draft feedback with Docs views hidden.

findings.title: Andromeda stop is ineffective while model preview is pending
reproduction: Delay the model preview response after requesting an overview.
Press the visible stop button before preview resolves.
Resolve preview and observe that the overview request still starts.
findings.expected: Stopping during preview prevents subsequent model submission and displays cancellation.
findings.actual: The abort controller is created only after preview/confirmation. The visible stop handler has nothing to cancel during preview.
evidence: Isolated in-memory execution of the actual startOverview function and click handler submitted /api/andromeda/overview with signalAborted false after stop.

Chromium 1440px and 390px actual pointer reproduction: stop left checking sources visible; overview POST followed after delayed preview resolved, 374ms/365ms after the click. Search/preview/overview transport explicitly mocked; no live model.
findings.verification: Nine behavioral JavaScript regressions (eight failed before repair) and real desktop/phone pointer checks verify immediate stop feedback, no late overview submission, preserved links, retry and superseded preview ownership. HTTP transports are explicitly simulated.
